Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer incorrectly stated Arrowhead Stadium’s capacity as 79,451 based on an unverified or misread search result and claimed it was “confirmed,” despite the visible authoritative snippet (and linked Wikipedia page) indicating 76,416. This reflects premature inference from search results without opening and validating the source, leading to the wrong figure.
